- No functional or documentation changes detected in this version.
- Internal version bumped to 1.0.1 without updates to the skill content or files.

Initial release of training-handbook-builder.

- Automatically generates professional Word training handbooks with cover, TOC, page numbers, color tables, tip boxes, and case highlights.
- Integrates latest policy, technical, and case research via WebSearch/WebFetch.
- Provides structured handbook template covering background, technology, use cases, tools, compliance, leadership, action planning, FAQ, and appendix.
- Supplies a step-by-step script (generate_handbook.py) for easy customization and document generation.
- Ensures professional print-ready layout, with Chinese font support, automated fields, and detailed formatting guidance.
